_note: Be still: Christ's own words, with Old Testament verses that point to Him. Berean Standard Bible clauses (public domain, bereanbible.com/bsb.txt) as placeholders; the NIV is fetched at build time by scripts/fetch_verses.py. Chosen by Claude for Matt's review, 2026-11-16.

entries.text: Be still
I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me
Prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness; make a straight highway for our God in the desert
Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God
I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life
But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities
I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel
I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst
I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit
And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives
See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
Behold, the virgin will be with child and give birth to a son, and will call Him Immanuel
Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself
Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind
For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
Love your neighbor as yourself
A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another
The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor
Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age
The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers
In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world
Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
Do not put the Lord your God to the test
Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing
Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights
Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit
It is finished
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief
the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel
Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me
I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness
For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost
I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many
Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free
I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End
For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them
God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son
blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed
If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me
He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face
You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
